niche: CRM, sales pipeline and back-office software for small and medium businesses in Ghana (contacts, leads, invoicing with VAT/NHIL/GETFund, payroll with SSNIT/PAYE, mobile money payments)
targetAudience: Owners, managers and sales leads at Ghanaian SMEs (5–100 staff) in retail, distribution, services and professional firms who currently run sales and customers on WhatsApp, Excel or paper and want something simpler and more organised
author: Adepa Team

brandVoice.tone: Practical, warm and direct — like an experienced Accra business consultant explaining something over coffee
style: Write for a busy owner: short paragraphs, concrete steps, real examples from Ghanaian business life (Makola traders, Kumasi distributors, Accra agencies)
Use Ghana cedi (GH₵) for money examples and local context (MoMo, GRA, SSNIT) where relevant
Explain jargon the first time it appears
Prefer numbered steps, checklists and small tables over long prose
Be honest about trade-offs and when a spreadsheet is genuinely enough
avoid: take it to the next level
brandVoice.productClaims: Adepa today offers multi-tenant workspaces, contacts/customers, leads and a sales pipeline. Invoicing (GRA VAT/levies), payroll (SSNIT/PAYE), HR and MoMo payments are on the roadmap — describe them as 'coming soon', never as available now.
brandVoice.factualityRules: Never invent statistics, studies or quotes. Ghanaian tax and SSNIT rates change often: describe how they work and tell readers to confirm current rates with GRA or SSNIT rather than stating precise percentages as permanent fact.
